content: “Not kabɨ ae dat kabɨ nandani. Nak gulusuŋ kɨnda dɨma agɨm do dayɨkdɨsat.”
Nandaba Pol Ibru genon da gen yaŋakwan upbalap dɨma aŋek tayaŋgok egɨpgwit. Yaŋ aŋakwa Pol da yaŋ yoyɨgɨt,

“Nak Juda amɨn kɨnda. Meŋno da Tasas kokup pap Silisia mɨktɨmon tosok uŋudon aŋalagɨt. Mani nak on kokup papmon tagagɨm. Yoyɨŋdetno Gamaliel uŋun da nak babɨknin dakon gen teban morap tagɨsi nayɨŋ dekgɨt. Ji Piŋkop dakon pi but dasi aŋ, nakyo kɨsi yaŋ gɨn aŋ kɨmakgɨm.
Nak da mɨŋat ae wɨli nandaŋ gadat aŋek Yesu Yolyol Kosit naŋ agɨpgwit uŋun paŋupbal aŋek dapbo kɨmotni do pi agɨm. Aŋek pabɨsɨŋ paŋpaŋ dam teban yutnon paŋkɨgɨm.

Yaŋ aŋapbo mukwa sogok amɨn dakon mibɨltok amɨn gat ae kɨla amɨn dakon gen kokwin amɨn kabɨ da nandaŋ namgwit, do nak da pi agɨm uŋun da ji tagɨ dayɨŋ teŋteŋoni. Uŋun da Juda amɨn notnin Damaskus egɨpgwit do papia kɨnda mandawit. Uŋun naba nak Yesu nandaŋ gadaŋ ɨmgwit amɨn kabɨ Damaskus egɨpgwit uŋun tɨmɨk paŋobɨŋ Jerusalem dam teban yutnon yopmaŋek kobogɨ do yo yokwi aŋyomni do aŋek kɨgɨm.”
Pol da but tobɨl agɨt dakon mibɨlɨ yoyɨgɨt
Pol saŋbeŋek yaŋ yagɨt, “Nak kɨŋ gɨldat binap 12 kilok da tɨlagon Damaskus aŋkapmat aŋapbo teŋteŋɨ madep kɨnda Kwen Kokup da pɨŋ aŋbinap aban nak binapmon akgɨm.
Teŋteŋaŋ naban nak mɨktɨmon maŋ pagek nandaŋapbo gen kɨnda altaŋek yaŋ nayɨgɨt, ‘Sol! Sol! Gak nido nak aŋupbal ak do pi asal?’
“Yaŋban yaŋ iyɨgɨm, ‘Amɨn Tagɨ gak namɨn?’ “Iyɨko yagɨt, ‘Nak Yesu Nasaret amɨn naŋ aŋupbal ak do pi asal.’
Amɨn nak gat agɨpgumaŋ uŋun teŋteŋɨ kawit. Mani gen uŋun nayɨgɨt uŋun dɨma nandawit.
“Nayɨŋban iyɨgɨm, ‘Amɨn Tagɨ, nak ninaŋ abeŋ?’ “Gen uŋun yoko Amɨn Tagɨ da nayɨgɨt, ‘Gak pɨdaŋ Damaskus kokupmon pɨgaki amɨn kɨnda da pi morap aki do yaŋ mudaŋ gamgum uŋun do gayɨsak.’
Teŋteŋɨ madep uŋun teŋteŋaŋ naban dabɨlno pɨlɨn tagɨt do amɨn agɨpgumaŋ uŋun da nak kɨsitnokon da abɨdaŋ Damaskus abɨgɨwit.
“Abɨgɨ nepba amɨn kɨnda mani Ananias nak nandak do apgut. Uŋun amɨn Piŋkop gawak ɨmɨŋek gen teban guramɨk kɨmakgɨt. Juda amɨn morap Damaskus egɨpgwit da nandaba amɨn kɨlegɨsi kɨnda agɨt.
Ananias uŋun kapmatjok da abɨŋ agek nak yaŋ nayɨgɨt, ‘Sol not, dabɨlgo aeni sɨŋtosak.’ Yaŋ nayɨŋban uŋudon gɨn sɨŋtaŋek Ananias kagɨm.
Kaŋapbo nayɨgɨt, ‘Babɨknin dakon Piŋkop da gak da niaŋsi abi do nandɨsak uŋun golɨŋban koki do manjɨŋ gepgut. Ae Amɨn Kɨlegɨ kaŋaki uŋun da iyɨ gen gayɨŋban nandaki do manjɨŋ gepgut.
Gak yo morap pɨndak nandaŋyo agɨl uŋun mɨŋat amɨn morap yoyɨŋ teŋteŋokdɨsal.
Do bɨsap noknok dɨma abi. Pɨdaŋek telagɨ pakbi soŋek mani yaŋaki uŋun da dɨwarɨgo wɨrɨrɨk gaban.’
“Don aeno Jerusalem tobɨl abɨŋ Telagɨ Yut Madepmon wɨgɨ bɨsit aŋ egek dabɨlno kulabɨk aŋakwan dɨpmɨn yombem kɨnda kagɨm.
Kaŋapbo Amɨn Tagɨ da yaŋ nayɨgɨt, ‘Gak tepmɨsi pɨdaŋ Jerusalem yɨpmaŋ kɨ. Nak dakon gen on kokup papmon yoyɨki kaŋ, amɨn da dɨma abɨdokdaŋ.’
“Nayɨŋban iyɨgɨm, ‘Amɨn Tagɨ, dɨma, on amɨn kalɨp nak da muwut muwut yut morapmon agek amɨn gak nandaŋ gadaŋ gamgwit uŋun baljaŋek dam tebanon yopgum uŋun nandaŋ namaŋ.

Ae gak dakon gen yaŋ teŋteŋok amɨngo Stiwen aŋakba kɨmakgɨt bɨsapmon nak kapmatjok agek tɨp baŋ aŋakgwit amɨn dakon ɨmal dubakni ɨlɨk yopmaŋ naba kɨla agɨm. Aŋek pɨndagapbo Stiwen aŋakba kɨmakban nandako tagɨsi agɨt.’
“Mani Amɨn Tagɨ da nayɨgɨt, ‘Nak da Amɨn Ŋwakŋwarɨ Kabɨ kokup dubagɨsikon ekwaŋ uŋun do kɨki do yabekdat.’ ”
Pol da emat amɨn nak Rom amɨn kɨnda yaŋ yoyɨgɨt
Pol da Amɨn Ŋwakŋwarɨ Kabɨ do gen uŋun yaŋakwan amɨn da nandaŋek yaŋ tɨdaŋek yawit, “Aŋakba kɨmakban. Uŋuden amɨn mɨktɨmon tagɨ dɨma egɨpmɨ.”
Yaŋ tɨdaŋek ɨmal dubakni ɨlɨk maba kɨŋakwa kɨmbabaŋ tɨmɨk maba kwen wɨgɨwit.

Yaŋ aŋakwa emat amɨn dakon mibɨltok amɨn da emat amɨni yaŋ yoyɨgɨt, “Ji Pol aŋkɨ nin ekwamaŋ yutnon baljoni. Baljaŋek amɨn da mibɨlɨ nido japmɨ nandaŋek yaŋ tɨdaŋ ɨmaŋ uŋun dakon mibɨlɨ iyɨ yaŋban nandani.”

Yoyɨŋban aŋkɨ kɨsit kandapyoni paŋnɨŋnɨŋ aŋek wamgwit. Aŋakwa Pol da kɨla amɨni kapmatjok akban kaŋek yaŋ iyɨgɨt, “Gen kokwin amɨn da nak dakon mibɨlno dɨma kaŋ nandaŋyo aŋakwa nak nɨtdaŋ. Uŋun tagɨ dɨma akdaŋ. Nak Rom amɨn kɨnda. Ji Rom dakon gen teban yapmaŋgaŋ.”
Yaŋban kɨla amɨni gen uŋun nandaŋ kɨŋ mibɨltok amɨni yaŋ iyɨgɨt, “Ma, on amɨn Rom amɨn kɨnda. Gak niaŋsi akdɨsal?”
Iyɨŋban kɨŋ Pol yaŋ iyɨgɨt, “Nayɨŋbɨ nandako. Gak Rom amɨn kɨnda?” Iyɨŋban yagɨt, “Asi nak Rom amɨn kɨnda.”
Yaŋban yaŋ yagɨt, “Nak Rom amɨnsi dagok do tomni madepsi yumgɨm.” Yaŋban Pol da iyɨgɨt, “Gak yaŋ agɨl mani nak altagɨmon da Rom amɨnsi kɨnda egɨpgum da egɨsat.”
Yaŋakwan amɨn Pol baljok do awit pasalek dɨma baljawit. Aŋakwa mibɨltok amɨn da Pol Rom amɨn kɨnda naŋ yoyɨko nap teban naŋ aŋteban ayɨŋ yaŋ kaŋ nandaŋyo aŋek uŋun kɨsi pasol pasol agɨt.
Pol gen kokwin amɨn kabɨkon gen yagɨt

Juda amɨn da Pol ni gulusuŋ naŋ agɨt do yoŋ, emat amɨn dakon mibɨltok amɨn uŋun dakon mibɨlɨ pakyaŋsi nandak do pi agɨt. Do gɨldat kɨnda do mukwa sogok amɨn dakon amɨn madep kabɨ ae Juda amɨn dakon gen kokwin amɨn morap abɨŋ muwutni do gen tebai yɨpgut. Yɨpban abɨŋ muwugakwa Pol dakon nap teban wɨtdal ɨmɨŋek abɨgɨ yɨpban uŋun da ɨŋamon akgɨt.
